proposed_widenings.name: per_active_time_charge_drain
proposed_widenings.justification: The Goat of Traveling has 24 charges where 'each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge.' This is a continuous charge drain while the summoned creature is active, not a per-activation cost. The existing charge_pool + resetCadence model charges per activation; there is no shape for 'drain N charges per unit of time while active'. A new subgraph connecting a charge_pool to an elapsed_time trigger that decrements the pool is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. While it has charges, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

proposed_widenings.name: creature_conditional_aura_while_ridden
proposed_widenings.justification: The Goat of Terror has a persistent Frightened-condition emanation (30-ft, DC 15 Wis save) that is active only while the owner is riding the creature. CreatureTraitEffect only supports caster_shared_resistance and caster_heal_link; there is no shape for a conditional on-turn save-gate aura on a summoned creature that activates on the 'while being ridden' condition. This requires either widening CreatureTraitEffect to support aura-style save gates, or a new 'while_ridden' conditional subgraph on creature actions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you ride the goat, any Hostile creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the goat must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until you are no longer riding the goat, or until the goat reverts to figurine form.

proposed_widenings.name: create_weapon_from_creature_part
proposed_widenings.justification: The Goat of Terror allows the owner to remove the goat's horns (as a Magic action) and use them as a +1 Lance and +2 Longsword. The weapons disappear when the goat reverts. There is no EffectAtom for creating weapons from a summoned creature's anatomy, nor for temporary item grants from a creature part. This is distinct from create_object (which creates environmental objects) and from grant_spell_access or modify_damage_numeric.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can (harmlessly) remove its horns and use them as weapons. One horn becomes a +1 Lance, and the other becomes a +2 Longsword. Removing a horn requires a Magic action, and the weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form.

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl.telepathy.rangeFeet = unlimited_same_plane
proposed_widenings.justification: The Serpentine Owl grants telepathy 'at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence.' The current CreatureControl.telepathy.rangeFeet field only accepts a number. A sentinel value or a discriminated union (e.g. { kind: 'same_plane' } | { kind: 'feet'; feet: number }) is needed to express same-plane unlimited telepathy.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The owl can communicate telepathically with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence.

proposed_widenings.name: creature_grants_owner_spell_while_active
proposed_widenings.justification: The Silver Raven grants the owner 'the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it while in raven form.' This is a mechanic where the summoned creature's existence passively confers a spell grant to its owner — not a creature action, not an activation effect on the owner, but a persistent owner-facing grant tied to the creature's active state. No current surface shape models 'while creature X is summoned, owner gains effect Y.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.

proposed_widenings.name: probabilistic_command_failure_with_persistent_ignore_state
proposed_widenings.justification: The Obsidian Steed has a 10% chance per use to 'ignore your orders, including a command to revert.' The random_table activation phase could fire a branch, but the resulting 'currently ignoring orders' state is persistent and affects subsequent interactions (mounting while ignoring orders triggers transport_exile to Hades). Tracking whether the creature is in an 'ignoring orders' state requires either a new persistent creature state flag or a per-activation random_table that produces a lasting behavioral override. Neither shape exists in the current surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The figurine has a 10 percent chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form. If you mount the nightmare while it is ignoring your orders, you and the nightmare are instantly transported to a random location on the plane of Hades, where the nightmare reverts to figurine form.

proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreatureStatBlock.catalog_ref_with_overrides
proposed_widenings.justification: The Onyx Dog is described as a Mastiff with Int 8, ability to speak Common, and Blindsight 60 ft. The current SpawnedCreatureStatBlock only supports 'inline' (full stat block) or 'catalog_ref' (name + monsterId, no overrides). An inline encoding would require restating all Mastiff stats, losing the semantic connection to the catalog entry. A catalog_ref_with_overrides variant (monsterId + partial stat block delta) would handle this and the Obsidian Steed's 'fights only to defend itself' behavioral restriction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The mastiff has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has Blindsight with a range of 60 feet.

notes: The collection has 9 named variants of widely varying complexity. Five variants (Bronze Griffon, Ebony Fly, Golden Lions, Marble Elephant, Goat of Travail) fit the existing MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics + catalog_ref pattern cleanly. The remaining four introduce mechanics that require structural or surface widenings: (1) Goat of Traveling's per-hour charge drain is the clearest structural gap — it needs a continuous resource depletion mechanic tied to active-form time, not per-activation cost; (2) Goat of Terror's ridden-conditional creature aura and weapon-creation-from-anatomy add two more structural gaps; (3) Serpentine Owl and Silver Raven add surface gaps (unlimited telepathy, owner-spell-while-active). Because the collection as a whole cannot be encoded honestly without omitting or fabricating major variant mechanics, no Dhall/JSON/trace was produced. The five clean variants are effectively encodable but the encoding would be incomplete without the others.
